topic: Gemini 4 Argon: Modernizing 40 year code (AI coding agents)
instruction: Capture with Muse's browser: open the target, take a screenshot (and a short screen recording if motion matters). In the render, show it FULL-SCREEN, zoomed 1.35x with smooth pan lined up to narration, cited text highlighted large as spoken (mouthfeed rule). If the browser cannot export a true screenshot, use its best in-system capture and record that limitation in the render manifest — never label a render as a live screenshot.
